household_message.text: Add 10 kWh to the car for quarter past seven tomorrow, and 21-22 in the house from 6 to 8.

message_to_household: I will charge the car with 10 kWh starting at quarter past seven tomorrow morning, using the usual charger and the lowest electricity prices available. The dishwasher will run until eight tomorrow morning, and the house will be kept between 21 and 22 degrees from six until eight tomorrow.

questions.text: The comfort band you requested overlaps with the dishwasher deadline: the house cannot be both warm enough and have the dishwasher finish by eight tomorrow. Which should take priority? Warmth or the dishwasher?
